## Description

Automated reminder/recall calls for patients without WhatsApp, and calls/messages to waitlisted patients when a slot frees; same identity and safety rules as inbound.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Calls are placed only to patients with a consent/opt-in for calls.
- [ ] **AC2.** Waitlist fill offers slots in order and books only on explicit confirmation.
- [ ] **AC3.** Call outcomes are logged as contact attempts and never close care tasks by themselves.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
